prompt: Some schools teach children of all abilities together in the same class, while others divide students into groups according to how well they perform. Discuss both approaches and give your own opinion.
essay:
In many countries the schools have the different systems for the teaching. In some schools all of the students study together in one class, but in other schools the students are divided by the their level. Both of the systems have the advantages and the disadvantages, and I will discuss the both of them in this essay.

Firstly, the supporters of the mixed classes say that this system is more fair. All of the children have the same opportunity and nobody feel that he is stupid. Moreover, the weak students can learn from the strong students, because they sit together and they help each other. Also, in the real life we must work with the different kinds of people, so the mixed class prepare the children for the future society. Also the teacher can give the special attention to the students who have the difficulty in some subject.

Secondly, other people prefer to divide the students by the ability. They say that the teacher can teach better when all of the students have the same level. If the class is mixed, the strong students become bored and the weak students cannot follow the lesson. Therefore nobody is happy. In addition, the clever students can go faster and maybe they will win the international competitions for their country.

In conclusion, the mixed class is better for the equality but the divided class is better for the results. Personally I think that the schools should divide the students only in the mathematics and the science, and teach the other subjects together.
title: Mixed-ability classes or setting by ability
